entries.title: Ask Firstmate to make the window larger or smaller
entries.body: Firstmate can now set the window's size to 100, 110, 125 or 150 percent when you ask. Every change of size, whether from Settings, ⌘+ and ⌘−, the View menu or Firstmate, now leaves a line in Activity that says who made it.
entries.noPicture: The window looks as it did at each size; what is new is that Firstmate can choose the size and that each change leaves an Activity line.
